title: Lu Xun's birth chart
metaDescription: Lu Xun's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 2.2° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Taurus — Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun sits at 2.2° Libra — the first decan, 0°–10°, which the tradition sub-rules by Venus. Degrees matter more than the sign label here: two people born a fortnight apart share Libra and share almost nothing else about where the Sun actually stood.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 20.3° Libra; Venus stands at 27.0° Leo; Mars stands at 0.4° Cancer. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate from Venus, drive that moves on certainty and current from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Uranus and Neptune hold the closest angle here — a trine, 0.9° wide. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Venus square Jupiter at 1.0°, and the Sun square Mars at 1.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has two entries for this chart. The Sun in Libra at 2.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Cancer at 0.4° is in fall. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements earth 5, air 3, fire 1, water 1; modalities fixed 5, cardinal 4, mutable 1. Earth weights a chart toward the material and the durable — what can be built, kept, and relied on. Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.7° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 21.5°.
